Class NativeDecisionModel

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeDecisionModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
DecisionModelRuntime
public final class NativeDecisionModel extends Object implements DecisionModelRuntime
The board's DecisionModelRuntime: compiler intrinsics for the native JEV1 evaluator, which reads either the table the build linked into flash or a PSRAM copy of an SD-card file in place, and Psram for that copy.
